A1.justification: Both PDFs describe LoMa: Local Feature Matching Revisited. The complete main texts and appendices A-E are readable, and equations, tables, and figures can be matched across relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: v1 reports original matching and localization experiments, HardMatch evaluations, training ablations, and additional empirical results in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original results and adds cumulative-data experiments, RUBIK difficulty analysis, and further Map-free evaluations.

M1.justification: The DaD/DeDoDe/LightGlue pipeline, losses, model variants, training recipe, and inference procedure remain unchanged. The new introduction sentence identifies rotation invariance as a separate subsequent work, not an implemented modification here.

E1.justification: The 17 training datasets and evaluation tasks are retained. The cumulative-data ablation uses existing training sources, RUBIK is analyzed within existing difficulty coverage, and the additional Map-free evaluation retains the same localization task.

E2.justification: Appendix A.9 and new Table 11 add MASt3R, LoFTR, and RoMa to the Map-free comparison, which previously reported sparse comparators in Table 3. These methods already appeared in other experiments, but their participation in Map-free is new.

E3.justification: The new cumulative-data experiment trains six LoMa-B configurations from scratch for 100K steps each. Figure 8 adds cumulative success-rate reporting across RUBIK difficulty levels, and Appendix A.9 adds official Map-free benchmark evaluation beyond the previously reported validation results. Existing experimental protocols are otherwise retained.

E4.justification: Figure 7 adds a targeted ablation of successive training-data additions, supplementing the earlier MegaDepth-versus-all-data analysis. Figure 8 adds a RUBIK difficulty breakdown for LoMa-B, ALIKED+LG, and SP+SG. Existing detector, keypoint-count, capacity, throughput, and appendix analyses remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports multi-seed uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests for model comparisons. The human-annotation error assessment is unchanged. The six added training configurations are different data mixtures, not reported repeated trials of one setting.

E6.justification: Existing benchmark-table scores remain unchanged, but Figure 6a replaces both loss trajectories and shows a smaller gap between MegaDepth and all-data training. Figures 7-8 add new results. New Table 11 reports Map-free validation precision/AUC of 73.4/91.6 for MASt3R versus LoMa-G's retained 68.9/90.3, alongside LoFTR and RoMa results. Appendix A.9 separately reports official-benchmark LoMa-G precision 75.7 and AUC 92.5; these are not same-setting improvements over validation.

T1.justification: The problem formulation, mathematical definitions, and equations (1)-(4) are unchanged. No new theoretical assumptions, derivations, propositions, or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, three stated contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about data scaling, HardMatch, and LoMa's performance. Added experiments support those claims; the rotation-invariance sentence explicitly concerns subsequent work.

C2.justification: v1 already noted rotation difficulties in Appendix A.4. v2 expands this into an explicit applicability limitation in Section 6 and identifies data augmentation and architectural approaches as remedies. Other interpretations and limitations are retained.

D1.justification: Section 5.5 specifies the model variant, initialization from scratch, and 100K-step budget for the six new data-ablation configurations. Appendix A.9 explicitly specifies shared DA3 depths for the added comparisons. Existing implementation, hardware, and code/data access statements remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds references covering rotation/equivariance and feed-forward reconstruction, including Steerers, Quick ViTs, Who Handles Orientation?, Dens3r, MapAnything, VGGT-omega, and DUSt3R. It also positions a rotation-invariant extension as subsequent work. The central research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: There are localized additions to the introduction, related work, experimental discussion, and limitations, plus new Appendix A.9. The section sequence and most prose are preserved, with reference-formatting cleanup and resulting text reflow.

P2.justification: v2 adds Figures 7-8 and Map-free Table 11, redraws Figure 6a, and rearranges several displays. The earlier correspondence Table 11 becomes Table 12, and appendix Figures 7-14 become Figures 9-16. Existing visual examples and the overall presentation style are retained.

improvement.justification: The cumulative-data ablation and RUBIK breakdown strengthen empirical support, while the added Map-free baselines provide a more balanced comparison, including MASt3R outperforming LoMa-G. These are useful, limited gains over an already extensive evaluation. The unexplained Figure 6a curve revision and unfinished 'TBD' caption in Table 11 temper the improvement.
